summary.text: Dennis Mahoney is running as an Independent for Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District. His campaign describes his career in disaster relief and long-term development and his work on cross-sector coalitions in Philadelphia, and lists five platform commitments: ending the benefits cliff, housing, neighborhood connectivity, family stability and generational wealth.

paragraphs.text: Is from South Philadelphia and was 34 years old as of September 2026, according to The Philadelphia Inquirer.

Has worked in disaster relief and humanitarian aid for about a decade, including through Food for the Hungry and a former Washington, D.C., church; the Inquirer reports he has dispatched aid after hurricanes in the United States and Puerto Rico and in poverty crises in 18 countries.
Founded AOI Solutions, a firm focused on disaster relief and humanitarian response, according to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.
First-time candidate who told the Inquirer he has belonged to both major parties; he qualified for the ballot with about 19,000 petition signatures, according to the Inquirer and his survey.

sources.title: Independent Dennis Mahoney is trying to defeat Chris Rabb in November
